elegirRegistro.subtitulo: Two different paths, and they don't cost the same. Choose yours.

club.texto: Create your club's page, publish your sponsorship opportunities and keep track of what you agree with each business.

empresa.texto: See which clubs are near you, what they need and for how much. Save the ones you like and write to them whenever you want.

elegirRegistro.mirarAntes: Would you rather look around before deciding?
elegirRegistro.mirarAntesEnlace: See the clubs without signing up

meta.descripcion: Choose whether you're a club looking for sponsors or a business that wants to support sport in its area.

registroClub.subtitulo: The first month is free. After that, €29.90/month including VAT.

registroEmpresa.sinCuentaAviso: You don't need an account to find clubs and write to them. <enlace>You can do it right now</enlace>. The account lets you publish what your business offers and save your favourites.

registroAdmin.subtitulo: For the ApoyaClub team only. You need the administrator key.
